assets.name: banner-750x400.jpg
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Draw ONE landscape, full-bleed illustration for a WeChat sticker album detail-page banner at 750 × 400 (15:8), no layout or panels. Reference images 1 and 2 are the SAME established character from this sticker album: use their likeness, hair shape and colors, ornament placement, costume, face and thick organic dark doodle outlines faithfully. GLM: dark charcoal fluffy animal ears with creamy tufts, long charcoal hair shading to cobalt at the ends, muted lavender eyes, white ruffled maid headband and her signature black sleeping mask pushed up onto her FOREHEAD, two simple white eyelash marks on the mask, actual eyes uncovered, small silver bells and ribbons at the viewer's right; black and white maid dress with blue bow. Match the lively hand-inked little chibi with broad opaque color blocks and a few crayon highlights in the references. No typography, readable letters, numbers, signatures or watermark anywhere. Scene: At a cozy plum-and-apricot window seat she stretches out a hand to catch a bright cobalt yarn ball rolling off a mustard-yellow cushion; a single sweeping curve of yarn leads from a small basket to the ball. Her real violet eyes are open in sleepy surprise and her fluffy animal ears perk. Bright honey light fills the colorful room. Side-on action with her face readable. Frame the single character large enough to recognize, with face, main prop and action fully inside the central 85% of the picture. Let background shapes fill all four sides. Give the image a rich colored opaque ground. Keep proportions natural, uncluttered silhouettes, one coherent moment, no white margin and no text.
assets.process: Proportional center crop to 750 × 400; JPEG quality 91, 4:4:4.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One square WeChat sticker album cover cutout, genuinely transparent RGBA outside the art. Reference images 1 and 2 are the SAME established character from this sticker album: use their likeness, hair shape and colors, ornament placement, costume, face and thick organic dark doodle outlines faithfully. GLM: dark charcoal fluffy animal ears with creamy tufts, long charcoal hair shading to cobalt at the ends, muted lavender eyes, white ruffled maid headband and her signature black sleeping mask pushed up onto her FOREHEAD, two simple white eyelash marks on the mask, actual eyes uncovered, small silver bells and ribbons at the viewer's right; black and white maid dress with blue bow. Match the lively hand-inked little chibi with broad opaque color blocks and a few crayon highlights in the references. No typography, readable letters, numbers, signatures or watermark anywhere. Pose: front-facing with a tiny amused sleepy smile, holding one loosely closed hand near her mouth to stifle a yawn, both real eyes visible below the mask, show maid bodice and blue waist bow. A single compact waist-up or three-quarter figure seen from the front, head and upper body distinct, entire silhouette contained with a little transparent breathing room on every side. Keep silhouette organic; hands and hair arranged so torso ends at a natural fabric curve, never a straight horizontal frame crop. Clear readable thick dark linework at 240px; no white sticker outline, cast shadow, gradient backing, border, scene, sparkles or floating props.
assets.process: Trim transparent margins using alpha ≥ 8 with two source pixels of padding, scale proportionally with Lanczos3, center on transparent canvas.

assets.name: icon-50x50.png
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Design ONE dedicated WeChat chat-tray icon on a genuinely transparent square background, optimized to look recognizable at 50 × 50 pixels. Reference images 1 and 2 are the SAME established character from this sticker album: use their likeness, hair shape and colors, ornament placement, costume, face and thick organic dark doodle outlines faithfully. GLM: dark charcoal fluffy animal ears with creamy tufts, long charcoal hair shading to cobalt at the ends, muted lavender eyes, white ruffled maid headband and her signature black sleeping mask pushed up onto her FOREHEAD, two simple white eyelash marks on the mask, actual eyes uncovered, small silver bells and ribbons at the viewer's right; black and white maid dress with blue bow. Match the lively hand-inked little chibi with broad opaque color blocks and a few crayon highlights in the references. No typography, readable letters, numbers, signatures or watermark anywhere. Draw only the character's HEAD from straight in front: a small sleepy smile, half-lidded uncovered violet eyes; black sleep mask above the bangs on her forehead and the two white eyelash curves kept legible at small scale, furry ears intact. No neck, chest, shoulders, hands, frames, extra flourishes or background. The complete organic contour fills almost the whole square with narrow even clearance at the edge. No white outline or sticker keyline. Smooth chunky dark edge, coherent color masses, strong readable expression and antialiased edges.
